🤝 Project Cooperation Guidelines - 💡 Before Contacting Us
content:
To save time and energy for both sides, clarify your requirements as soon as possible, and provide a reasonable quote and timeline, we hope you can prepare a requirements document for the application you want to develop before contacting us.

Writing a requirements document will help you review your own project and clarify your project expectations. A clear requirements document also makes it easier for you to compare different service providers and reduces misunderstandings during communication caused by vague requirements.

If you do not know how to write a requirements document, here are some examples. They are not mandatory and are for reference only.

Project background and goals: introduce the origin of the project, the problems it needs to solve, and the overall project goals.

Functional requirements: list the functions the system needs to implement, including user interface, role permissions, processing logic, and more.

Non-functional requirements: list performance indicators, security requirements, availability, reliability, usability, and other non-functional requirements.

UI design requirements: describe the design style, layout, icons, colors, and other interface-related requirements of the system.

Test plan and acceptance criteria: define the system test plan and acceptance criteria to ensure effective testing after development is completed.

Implementation constraints and limitations: list any technical limitations, such as programming language, framework, operating system, and more.

Timeline and milestones: clarify the project schedule and milestones to ensure timely completion and expected results.



Cooperation Process
Based on your requirements document, we will further communicate to clarify the requirements and then provide a quote.
Sign the contract.
Pay the deposit.
Design / Development.
Testing and acceptance.
Pay the remaining balance.
Launch and operation.
Provide 1–6 months of free maintenance based on the project scale, excluding new requirement changes.
Long-term technical support can be provided later on an hourly basis, including requirement updates, application upgrades, and maintenance.

title: 📬 Privacy Policy for iHogu AI Sidebar
content:
Privacy Policy for iHogu AI SidebarEffective Date: August 20, 2026Last Updated: August 20, 2026
iHogu AI Sidebar (“iHogu”, “we”, “our”, or “the Extension”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information the Extension may access or process, how that information is used, and the choices available to you.
By using iHogu AI Sidebar, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
1. Information We Access and ProcessiHogu AI Sidebar may access or process the following information only when necessary to provide features requested by the user.
Website ContentWhen you actively use features such as webpage summarization, translation, explanation, rewriting, or contextual AI questions, the Extension may access:

Text visible on the current webpage
Text you select on a webpage
The title and URL of the current webpage
Other webpage content necessary to perform the specific AI-assisted action you request

The Extension does not continuously monitor your browsing activity.
Website content is accessed only when required to provide a user-requested feature.
User InputWe may process text, prompts, questions, or instructions that you voluntarily enter into the iHogu AI Sidebar.
Extension SettingsThe Extension may store settings and preferences such as:

Interface preferences
Custom prompts
Feature settings
Language preferences
Other configuration information

These settings may be stored locally in your browser using Chrome extension storage.
2. How We Use InformationInformation processed by iHogu AI Sidebar is used only to provide and improve the functionality requested by the user, including:

Summarizing webpage content
Answering questions about webpage content
Translating text
Explaining selected content
Rewriting or improving text
Providing AI-assisted browsing features
Remembering user preferences and extension settings
Maintaining the reliability and security of the Extension

We do not use webpage content to create advertising profiles.
3. AI Processing and Third-Party ServicesSome iHogu AI Sidebar features may use third-party artificial intelligence or infrastructure service providers.
When you actively request an AI-powered feature, the relevant webpage content, selected text, prompt, or other necessary information may be transmitted securely to these service providers so that your request can be processed.
Only information reasonably necessary to perform the requested feature is transmitted.
Third-party service providers process information according to their own privacy policies and applicable agreements.
4. Information We Do Not SelliHogu does not sell, rent, or trade personal information or browsing data to advertisers, data brokers, or other third parties.
We do not use user data for:

Targeted advertising
Creditworthiness assessment
Selling user profiles
Unrelated marketing
Tracking users across unrelated websites
Creating browsing-history profiles

5. Browsing HistoryiHogu AI Sidebar is designed to work with the webpage you are currently viewing.
We do not intentionally collect or maintain a history of all websites you visit.
Access to webpage content is used only as necessary to provide features that you actively request.
6. PermissionsiHogu AI Sidebar may request Chrome permissions necessary for its functionality.
These permissions may include:
activeTabAllows the Extension to interact with the currently active webpage when you actively invoke the Extension.
scriptingAllows the Extension to access relevant content from the current webpage when necessary to perform a requested AI action.
contextMenusAllows the Extension to provide right-click actions for selected text, such as summarizing, translating, explaining, or rewriting content.
sidePanelAllows iHogu AI Sidebar to display its interface alongside the webpage you are viewing.
storageAllows the Extension to save preferences, settings, and other configuration information required for normal operation.
Any permissions requested by the Extension are intended only to support its stated functionality.
7. Data RetentionWe aim to minimize data retention.
Information sent for AI processing is used to fulfill the user’s requested action and is not intentionally retained by iHogu longer than reasonably necessary for providing, securing, or maintaining the service.
Locally stored extension preferences may remain in your browser until you change them, clear browser data, or uninstall the Extension.
Third-party service providers may apply their own data-retention policies.
8. Data SecurityWe take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information processed by iHogu AI Sidebar.
Where information is transmitted to servers or third-party service providers, we use secure network connections such as HTTPS whenever applicable.
However, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
9. Sensitive InformationYou should avoid submitting highly sensitive information through the Extension unless necessary.
This may include:

Passwords
Authentication credentials
Government identification numbers
Financial account information
Medical information
Other highly confidential personal information

iHogu AI Sidebar is not designed to intentionally collect this information.
10. Children’s PrivacyiHogu AI Sidebar is not directed toward children under the age required by applicable law to independently consent to data processing.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
11. Your ChoicesYou control when iHogu AI Sidebar processes webpage content.
You may:

Choose whether to activate AI features
Avoid submitting particular webpage content
Delete locally stored extension settings
Disable the Extension
Uninstall the Extension at any time through Chrome

Uninstalling the Extension removes its access to your browser.
12. Chrome Web Store User DataiHogu AI Sidebar handles user data only for purposes directly related to the Extension’s user-facing features.
We do not transfer or use user data for purposes unrelated to providing or improving the Extension’s functionality, except where required for security, legal compliance, or other purposes permitted by applicable law and Chrome Web Store policies.
13. International Data ProcessingDepending on the infrastructure and AI service providers used by iHogu AI Sidebar, information necessary to process a request may be processed on servers located in countries or regions different from your own.
By using AI-powered features, you acknowledge that such processing may occur where necessary to provide the requested service.
14. Changes to This Privacy PolicyWe may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect:

Changes to iHogu AI Sidebar
New features
Changes to service providers
Legal or regulatory requirements
Chrome Web Store policy requirements

When material changes are made, the “Last Updated” date at the top of this Privacy Policy will be revised.
15. ContactIf you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or iHogu AI Sidebar’s privacy practices, please contact us through the contact information published on the official iHogu website:
Website: https://ihogu.com
